overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Louisiana State University Shreveport (LSU Shreveport) Pilots baseball team for winning the 2025 national championship of the National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA), an association of mostly smaller colleges. The team finished 59-0, which the resolution describes as the first perfect season in college baseball history, and it was the school's first national title in any sport. It also recognizes the tournament's top players and the head coach. The resolution asks that formal copies be sent to the university's chancellor, athletic director and coach. The Senate agreed to it on July 21, 2025.
for: Supporters say a historic undefeated season and a school's first national title deserve national recognition.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
